review.posthog_relevance: Adds test coverage and implementation for push notification open event tracking and metric attribution, supporting the push notification workflow and its associated app-metrics.
review.reason: The change adds a test asserting push notification open event attribution, imports the push-open-tracking module, and adds a call to track push notification opens in the event processing pipeline. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement for push notification tracking and metric emission.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit and adoption are not demonstrated; this is a code implementation and test addition, not a measurement of user benefit or incident avoidance.
